dct_description_sm: To catalogue the marine invertebrates inhabiting the south end of the Hell Gate - Cardigan Strait polynya. This catalogue was used in determining diet selection by northern fulmar and black guillemot colonies on the eastern tip of Colin Archer Peninsula. A more contemporary use of this catalogue is to provide a taxonomic baseline of the invertebrates inhabiting these waters.
dct_title_s: Nearshore Marine Invertebrates off Colin Archer Peninsula, western Jones Sound, Nunavut
